steps.title: Prepare all reagents and solutions
steps.instruction: Make each solution listed in the Recipes section exactly as described, using the specified amounts, solvents, filtration steps, storage temperatures, and aliquoting procedures.

substeps.instruction: 0.1% gelatin solution: dissolve 0.2 g gelatin in 200 ml PBS, sterile‑filter (0.2 µm Stericup GP 500 ml), aliquot, store at 4 °C.
10 mg/ml doxycycline stock: dissolve 10 mg doxycycline in 1 ml sterile distilled water, aliquot, store at –20 °C; thaw a fresh aliquot before use.
5 mg/ml ascorbic acid stock: dissolve 0.5 g ascorbic acid in 100 ml sterile distilled water, sterile‑filter (0.2 µm Stericup GP 150 ml), aliquot, store at –20 °C; thaw a fresh aliquot before use.
D4T endothelial cell supernatant: prepare according to Choi et al., aliquot, store at –20 °C; after thaw keep at 4 °C and use within one month.
PBS + 0.1 % BSA solution: dissolve 0.05 g BSA in 50 ml PBS, sterile‑filter (Millex‑GP syringe filter), aliquot, store at –20 °C.
10 µg/ml VEGF stock: dissolve a 10 µg VEGF vial in 1 ml PBS + 0.1 % BSA, aliquot, store at –80 °C; after thaw keep at 4 °C and use within one month.
10 µg/ml IL‑6 stock: dissolve a 10 µg IL‑6 vial in 1 ml PBS + 0.1 % BSA, aliquot, store at –80 °C; after thaw keep at 4 °C and use within one month.
Conditioned IMDM: mix 1 bottle IMDM with 5 ml L‑glutamine and 5 ml penicillin‑streptomycin; store at 4 °C.
IMDM + 20 % FBS: combine 30 ml FBS with 120 ml conditioned IMDM, sterile‑filter (Stericup TM 150 ml bottle).
MTG dilution (fresh): add 13 µl MTG to 1 ml conditioned IMDM, mix well (MTG is viscous).

BL‑CFC culture medium (fresh): in a 50 ml Falcon tube combine 14.49 ml conditioned IMDM, 2 ml FBS, 0.2 ml L‑glutamine, 0.12 ml transferrin, 0.06 ml MTG dilution, 0.1 ml 5 mg/ml ascorbic‑acid stock, 3 ml D4T endothelial cell supernatant, 0.01 ml 10 µg/ml VEGF stock, 0.02 ml 10 µg/ml IL‑6 stock; sterile‑filter (Millex‑GP syringe filter).

steps.title: Coat wells with gelatin
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml per well of the 0.1 % gelatin solution to eight wells of a Costar 6‑well plate (one plate of four wells per cell line) and leave at room temperature for at least 20 min.

steps.title: Harvest and resuspend Flk1+ cells
steps.instruction: For each cell line, count 0.425 million Flk1⁺ cells (from ESC differentiation) with a Neubauer chamber, add them to a 15‑ml Falcon tube containing 5 ml IMDM + 20 % FBS, centrifuge at 290 × g for 5 min, aspirate the supernatant with a vacuum‑connected pipet, tap the tube to loosen the pellet, and resuspend the pellet in 8.5 ml fresh BL‑CFC culture medium. Use separate pipets and tips for each line to avoid cross‑contamination.

steps.title: Plate cells onto coated wells
steps.instruction: Aspirate the gelatin from the pre‑coated wells, then distribute 2 ml of the cell suspension into each of four gelatin‑coated wells per line (0.1 million cells per well). Gently agitate the plate with small vertical and horizontal jolts (avoid circular vortex motions). Incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 24 h. Keep any remaining BL‑CFC medium in the refrigerator for the doxycycline dilution the next day. Ensure cells are evenly spread to prevent confluence‑related differentiation delays.

steps.title: Prepare doxycycline working dilution
steps.instruction: In a tube kept in the refrigerator, mix 4 µl of the 10 mg/ml doxycycline stock with 196 µl BL‑CFC culture medium (prepared the previous day) to obtain a 0.2 µg/µl doxycycline solution; mix well.

steps.title: Add doxycycline or control to wells
steps.instruction: Remove the plates from the incubator and inspect wells under a microscope for uniformity. Add 10 µl of the 0.2 µg/µl doxycycline solution to each +dox well (two wells per line) to reach a final doxycycline concentration of 1 µg/ml; add the drop to the centre of the well and gently agitate the plate. Add 10 µl of BL‑CFC culture medium to each –dox well (two wells per line) as a control. Return plates to the incubator and place them carefully into the IncuCyte HD microscope, avoiding any writing on the lid and preventing splashes that could impair the device.

steps.title: Configure IncuCyte imaging parameters
steps.instruction: On the computer, open the IncuCyte software, connect to the device and log in. In the Task List panel click “Schedule Upcoming Scans”. In the Drawer Setup window select an empty vessel, right‑click the location of the first plate and choose “New”. Keep this vessel selected and set in the Scan Setup tab: Tray Type = Microplates, Vessel Type = 6‑well Corning, Scan Type = Phase Contrast, Scan Pattern = appropriate (or edit), Images per well = 16. In the Properties tab fill in Label, Cell type, and Passage number. In Plate Map click “Add a new compound”, name it “+dox”, select the doxycycline‑treated wells, set the concentration, and confirm. Repeat the vessel setup for the second plate. Right‑click the upper timeline, choose “Set intervals”, set imaging every 15 min starting at time 0 for a total of 24 h, and click “Apply”. After placing the plates in the incubator wait at least 30 min for lid condensation to clear before the microscope can focus properly; check after 15 min that imaging is proceeding and optionally switch off the computer.

steps.title: Terminate imaging and collect plates
steps.instruction: On Day 3 (after 48 h treatment) return to the IncuCyte Task List, click “Schedule Upcoming Scans”, right‑click the timeline and select “Delete Intervals”, then click “Apply” to stop scanning. Remove the plates from the incubator and proceed with flow‑cytometry analysis according to standard protocols.
